visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation starts with a black title screen followed by a yellow stick figure lying on a dark blue background with several red message icons floating above a glowing phone. The scene transitions to a boy with dark hair and a grey t-shirt against a grey background waving his hand. Then back to the yellow stick figure in various poses: curled up, lying face down, and finally sleeping in a purple bed under a yellow blanket. (2) The boy character returns, rubbing his chin in a thinking gesture. The background changes to a rendition of Edvard Munch's 'The Scream' painting with a dejected figure in the foreground. (3) A yellow stick figure walks across the screen with a thermometer and a progress bar above its head, which turns from green to red. The background is dark grey with wavy lines. The figure then slumps its shoulders as labels '平淡' (Plain), '疏離' (Detached), and '獨處' (Solitude) appear. A cute grey circular mascot with a starry eye appears, blushing and saying '我很冷漠!'. (4) The boy character holds a white paper, looking concerned. A stick figure appears whose body is half blue and half red, like a battery meter. The figure lies down on its back, and a dotted circle labeled '個人安全區界線' (Personal Safety Zone) forms around it. Finally, the figure turns fully blue, smiles, and is surrounded by colorful flowers against a dark blue background.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 間歇性冷漠——突然不想理人. [Logo]: 維他維. (2) [Subtitle]: 你有過這樣的時候嗎. (3) [Subtitle]: 有時候突然不想回訊息, 不想社交, 對周圍的事突然沒興趣, 只想一個人靜靜待著. (4) [Subtitle]: 這不是你變了, 而是一種情緒狀態, 叫做間歇性冷漠. (5) [Subtitle]: 當我們長期處在壓力中, 或者對周圍太過共情, 情緒可能會短暫的「關機」. (6) [Variety]: 平淡. [Variety]: 疏離. [Variety]: 獨處. [Subtitle]: 變得平淡、疏離、不太想敞開心扉、更喜歡獨處, 甚至有點冷漠. (7) [Slogan]: 我很冷漠!. [Logo]: 維他維. (8) [Subtitle]: 那是中二不是冷漠. (9) [Subtitle]: 雖然「間歇性冷漠」不是正式心理學術語, 但有專業人士認為, 這其實是一種自我保護機制. (10) [Subtitle]: 當情緒快沒電時, 偶爾抽離、建立個人安全區界線, 能讓自己喘口氣, 然後慢慢恢復原本的狀態. [Variety]: 躺平. [Slogan]: 個人安全區界線.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator speaks with a clear, professional, yet friendly tone at a moderate pace. The background music is a soft, upbeat acoustic guitar melody with a steady, gentle rhythm. Short, high-pitched digital 'ping' sound effects are heard simultaneously with the appearance of message icons. (2) The narration continues with consistent pitch and friendly tone. A distinct mechanical 'clunk' or 'power-down' sound effect occurs when the term 'shut down' is mentioned. The acoustic BGM maintains its volume and tempo in the background. (3) The male speaker continues explaining the psychological state. A playful, cartoonish 'boing' sound effect accompanies the appearance of the mascot character. The ambient sound floor is clean, resembling a studio recording. (4) The narrator’s voice becomes slightly more reassuring. A digital 'recharging' or 'humming' sound effect is heard as the figure lies down. At the very end, a bright, sparkly 'twinkle' sound effect plays as flowers appear, signaling a positive recovery state. BGM fades out slightly towards the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Definition -> Root Cause -> Biological/Psychological Purpose -> Recovery Mechanism
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate the audience about 'Intermittent Apathy' (間歇性冷漠), explaining it not as a negative personality change but as a natural psychological self-defense mechanism triggered by stress or emotional exhaustion. It seeks to normalize these feelings and provide a path toward emotional recovery through temporary detachment.

high_inference.freeDescribe: This is a typical 'knowledge sharing' short-form video that uses character-based animation to represent abstract psychological concepts, making them accessible to a general audience.
